_comment: Copy this file to data/config.json and adjust. data/ is gitignored because config.json holds your password.
_host_comment: 0.0.0.0 = reachable from other devices on the LAN. Use 127.0.0.1 to allow this machine only.
_password_comment: Empty = no login required. Set a password before exposing this server to any network: the web terminals (PowerShell and SSH) are only enabled when a password is set.
_refreshMs_comment: Sampling interval in ms. Raise it (3000-5000) on a slow machine; the dashboard shows the monitor's own cost per sample.
_historyMinutes_comment: How much history to keep in memory for the charts. Nothing is written to disk.

safety._comment: Services this tooling must never stop. Remove "dsh" to allow the UI to restart it. Note that a process hosting the current session is additionally protected by an ancestry check.

_tunnels_comment: Optional. frp tunnel endpoints, shown in the UI for reference. Example: [{ "name": "HwMonitor", "local": "127.0.0.1:8080", "remote": "example.com:18080" }]. Left empty here so a deployment's public addresses are not published.

pricing._comment: Per-million-token rates. All default to 0 on purpose: HwMonitor does not guess vendor prices, so costs show as 0 and are labelled 'unpriced' until you fill these in.
